### Wonderful Counselor, Wonderful Child
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-december-3-2023.html
Passage: Isaiah 9:6
Points:
- God's ultimate answer to the world's oppression and darkness was sending a child rather than military power.
- Earthly kings rely on human advisers, but Jesus Himself is the Wonderful Counselor needing no outside wisdom.
- Christ holds absolute perfection and supreme authority to govern with lasting righteousness.
- Believers are challenged to surrender their own plans and trust His counsel in all circumstances.

### How to Worship Through the Wonder of Christ’s Birth
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/how-to-worship-through-the-wonder-of-christs-birth-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Isaiah 9:6
Points:
- Isaiah's prophecy balances Christ's genuine human birth with His divine identity and power.
- As the Wonderful Counselor, Jesus provides guidance that cuts through confusion in difficult decisions.
- As Mighty God and Everlasting Father, He offers omnipotent strength and protective, unchanging care.
- As Prince of Peace, He grants spiritual reconciliation with God and calm amid earthly stress.
